Cena Restaurant Partner Terms

Effective date: [DATE] · Operator: [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME] · Contact: [PARTNER SUPPORT EMAIL] · [MAILING ADDRESS]

These terms govern a restaurant’s participation in Cena, including menu listings, order acceptance, and pickup fulfillment. The individual accepting for the restaurant represents that they are authorized to bind the restaurant. “Restaurant” includes the participating business and its authorized staff members. By accepting an invitation, creating a restaurant workspace, or using the partner tools, the Restaurant agrees to these terms and the Privacy Policy.

1. Service and launch payment flow

Cena provides tools to publish meal-kit listings and receive and manage customer pickup orders. In the initial release, customers pay the Restaurant directly at pickup; Cena does not collect or remit customer payments. Restaurant must not represent that Cena processes payment. No commission, subscription, or other fee is charged unless the parties separately accept a written fee schedule or order form identifying the fee and its effective date.

Cena does not prepare, own, inspect, or deliver food. The Restaurant is the seller of the food and is responsible for each order from acceptance through handoff to the customer.

2. Restaurant responsibilities

The Restaurant will:

  • Provide complete, current, and accurate business, location, menu, price, ingredient, allergen, nutrition, availability, and pickup information, and promptly correct errors or changes.
  • Ensure it has all permits, licenses, registrations, insurance, and staff training required for its operations; comply with applicable food-safety, labeling, consumer-protection, accessibility, privacy, and other laws.
  • Prepare and package orders safely and as described, honor confirmed orders, make them available at the stated location and pickup window, and keep order status current in Cena.
  • Set and clearly disclose its customer-facing cancellation, missed-pickup, refund, and complaint practices before accepting orders; handle payment, refunds, food complaints, and customer remedies directly.
  • Use only photos, marks, descriptions, and other content it owns or is authorized to use, and ensure the content does not mislead or infringe another party’s rights.
  • Ensure that only staff members who need access use their own credentials; remove staff access promptly when it is no longer needed and notify Cena of suspected account compromise.

The Restaurant must not discriminate unlawfully, submit fraudulent or test orders as real orders, misuse customer information, scrape or reverse engineer the Service, or use Cena to send unsolicited marketing.

3. Orders and customer information

The Restaurant decides whether to accept an order and must keep availability accurate. An order is binding on the Restaurant when it is marked confirmed in the partner tools. The Restaurant must promptly notify the customer through the available order workflow if it cannot fulfill a confirmed order and should provide any legally required remedy. Cena may relay order information and service messages but does not guarantee delivery of a message.

The Restaurant may use customer information made available through an order only to accept, prepare, fulfill, and support that order; comply with law; and resolve a related safety or service issue. It must not add customers to a marketing list, profile them, sell or disclose their information, or retain it for unrelated use without a separate lawful basis and any required notice or consent. The Restaurant is responsible for its own handling of customer information and privacy notices. Notify [PRIVACY CONTACT] promptly of a suspected unauthorized access or disclosure involving Cena customer information.

Each party will comply with the privacy and security duties that apply to it. If the parties later need a data processing or data-sharing agreement, they will execute one before enabling the relevant processing.

4. Staff memberships and workspace security

The Restaurant is responsible for its staff members’ actions in its workspace. It will designate an administrator, provide access only to authorized personnel, use individual accounts, protect credentials, and remove departing or unauthorized users promptly. Cena may suspend a compromised account or workspace to protect users or the Service. Restaurant must notify [PARTNER SUPPORT EMAIL] promptly of any suspected compromise.

5. Cena name and Restaurant content

The Restaurant grants Cena a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license during participation to host, reproduce, format, display, distribute, and promote the Restaurant’s submitted name, logo, menu, descriptions, and images solely to operate and promote the Service. The Restaurant represents it has the rights needed to grant this license. The Restaurant can request correction or removal of content by contacting [PARTNER SUPPORT EMAIL]. Cena retains its rights in the Service, software, and Cena branding.

6. Suspension and termination

Either party may end participation at any time by written notice to the other. Cena may suspend a listing or workspace, or terminate participation, if the Restaurant materially breaches these terms, creates a safety or legal concern, misuses customer information, or threatens the security or operation of the Service. When practical, Cena will explain the issue and allow a reasonable opportunity to correct it. The Restaurant remains responsible for confirmed orders already accepted and must make reasonable efforts to notify affected customers if it cannot fulfill them.

Upon termination, Cena may remove the Restaurant’s listings and disable workspace access. The Restaurant must stop using Cena customer information except as needed to complete existing orders, meet legal obligations, or resolve disputes, and must delete or return it when those needs end, subject to applicable law. Sections addressing payment obligations, data use, intellectual property, liability, and disputes survive as applicable.

7. Disclaimers and limits

Cena provides the Service “as is” and “as available,” to the extent permitted by law. Cena does not guarantee customer traffic, order volume, uninterrupted operation, or the accuracy of user-submitted information. The Restaurant remains solely responsible for its food, staff, premises, permits, customer transactions, and legal compliance.

To the extent permitted by law, neither party will be liable to the other for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages or lost profits. To the extent permitted by law, each party’s total liability arising from these terms will not exceed US $1,000. This cap does not apply to a party’s intentional misconduct, infringement or misuse of the other party’s intellectual property, breach of confidentiality or data-use duties, or liability that cannot legally be limited. The parties should have counsel review the allocation and cap before launch.

8. Independent businesses; indemnity

The parties are independent contractors. These terms do not create an agency, partnership, joint venture, employment, or franchise relationship. Neither party may bind the other. The Restaurant is responsible for its employees, taxes, and operations.

To the extent permitted by law, the Restaurant will defend and indemnify Cena and its personnel against third-party claims, losses, and reasonable costs arising from the Restaurant’s food or premises, its breach of these terms, its violation of law, or its submitted content, except to the extent caused by Cena’s negligence, willful misconduct, or breach. The Restaurant may not settle a claim in a way that imposes liability or an admission on Cena without Cena’s written consent.

9. Disputes and general terms

The parties will first try to resolve disputes through good-faith discussions between their designated contacts. These terms are governed by the laws of [STATE], without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Courts located in [COUNTY, STATE] have jurisdiction, subject to mandatory law. If a provision is unenforceable, the rest remains effective. Neither party may assign these terms without the other’s consent, except to an affiliate or successor in a merger or sale of substantially all relevant assets. Cena may update these terms by posting a revised version and giving reasonable notice; material changes apply prospectively. Continued participation after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

10. Notices and contact

Notices to Cena: [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME], [MAILING ADDRESS], [PARTNER SUPPORT EMAIL]. Notices to the Restaurant may be sent to its administrator email on file. Privacy/security reports: [PRIVACY CONTACT].
